goals.objective:
Prompt Paul whole-extension UX refinement implementation. Canonical plan:

1. Foundation — Extend existing theme tokens, create shared UI primitives, and standardize run/feedback states.
2. Chat-first slice — Implement the composer-led chat workflow: visible context tray; contextual quick-action row; inline Stop/Retry/Edit/Continue recovery; visible-but-secondary capabilities.
3. Options — Apply the same patterns to setup and management: chat-led setup; explicit section saves; separate capability sections; masked credentials and unsaved-change protection.
4. Entry points — Redirect context-menu actions and deep links into canonical chat while preserving page, selection, media, and attachment context.
5. Compatibility — Preserve existing storage schemas, profiles, capabilities, backups, and all current workflows. Retire nothing.
6. Coordinated release — Ship the complete UX together after internal milestones.
7. Validation — Run the three representative journeys and verify: no data loss; no broken entry paths; theme/responsive behavior; context continuity; capability parity; WCAG AA best-effort compliance.

Complete and verify all phases, preserving all existing workflows with no data loss.
